title: SOV Schematic Run Receipt
description: Documentation only: receipts are built by runReceipt in src/07-state-space.js. The one receipt every run operation returns on every surface (browser API, HTTP, MCP): schematic.run.start, .step, .settle, .trace, schematic.state.query and schematic.run.replay (STATE-SPACE.md, Surfaces). Running never changes the document, its revision, history or recovery. The HTTP status is the only surface-specific field and is not part of the receipt.

runId.description: the run's id (the first 12 hex digits of its replay key's hash); null when no run was found or started

tickBefore.description: the run's last processed tick before the operation (null before any, and for start and replay)

tickAfter.description: the run's last processed tick after the operation

head.description: the hash of the run's last ledger entry after the operation, which a truncated trace cannot match

result.description: null on a refusal. start: the start ledger entry's body {replayKey, budget}; step: {tick, records}; settle: {kind: quiet} | {kind: oscillating, period, subjects} | {kind: budget, left}; trace: the trace (trace@0.1); state.query: the matching state records, in record order; replay: {records}

code.description: RUN_NOT_FOUND, INPUT_INVALID, PACK_INVALID, QUERY_INVALID, RUN_INVALID, RUN_REFUSED, MERGE_FORM, BUDGET_SPENT (step), TRACE_INVALID, REPLAY_KEY_MISMATCH or REPLAY_DIVERGED
